default.description: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.

acceptEdits.description: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.

bypassPermissions.title: Bypass Permissions
bypassPermissions.description: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.

technicalInfo.default: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=untrusted. Trusted commands: cat, cd, grep, head, ls, pwd, tail, git status/log/diff/show, find (without -exec), etc.
technicalInfo.acceptEdits: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=never. All commands auto-execute within project directory.
technicalInfo.bypassPermissions: sandboxMode=danger-full-access, approvalPolicy=never. Full system access, use only in trusted environments.
technicalInfo.overrideNote: You can override this per-session using the mode button in the chat interface.

nineRouter.title: 9Router
nineRouter.description: Optionally route new Claude, Codex, and OpenCode sessions through your own 9Router service.

preservation.title: Native agent access stays intact
preservation.nativeLogin: Native OAuth, subscriptions, API keys, and CLI credentials remain available and unchanged. Disconnecting 9Router never signs an agent out.
preservation.usageAdvisory: Usage alerts are advisory only. Routed failures are shown explicitly and never fall back silently to native credentials.

secureStorage.title: Secure storage is unavailable
secureStorage.description: Set a valid ROUTING_SECRET_KEY on the server before saving write-only 9Router credentials.

offline.title: 9Router is offline
offline.description: CloudCLI could not reach the configured endpoint. Native agent login remains available.

unauthorized.title: 9Router credentials were rejected
unauthorized.description: Check the admin password and data-plane API key. Existing native agent credentials were not changed.

incompatible.title: This 9Router version has limited compatibility
incompatible.description: Only capabilities reported by this version are enabled. CloudCLI does not guess unsupported management APIs.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: All browser requests stay on CloudCLI. The server connects to the approved 9Router origin.
connection.endpointHelp: Use a remote HTTPS origin. Loopback HTTP requires an explicit server deployment opt-in.
connection.writeOnlyHelp: Credentials are write-only. Saved values are encrypted by the server and are never returned to this page.

modelSource.title: Model source
modelSource.description: Choose the default source for new sessions. Existing sessions keep the source captured when they were created.
modelSource.nativePreserved: Native login remains configured and can be selected at any time.
modelSource.cursorUnsupported: Cursor is native-only in this release. Its login and runtime are unchanged.
modelSource.noRoutes: Create a route in 9Router before selecting it as a model source.
modelSource.noFallback: No silent fallback: if a routed run fails, CloudCLI reports the failure instead of using native credentials.

management.title: Upstreams and routes
management.description: Manage the 9Router accounts and ordered model routes used by routed sessions.
management.connectFirst: Connect 9Router before loading upstream accounts and routes.
management.unavailable: This 9Router version does not expose supported account or route management APIs.
management.loadFailed: Could not load upstream accounts and routes.

accounts.title: Upstream accounts
accounts.description: Accounts remain authoritative in 9Router. CloudCLI displays only safe status fields.
accounts.apiKeyOnly: API-key accounts only are supported for creation in this release.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.noProviders: No provider catalog is available for a new account.
accounts.empty: No upstream accounts were returned by 9Router.
accounts.unavailable: Account details are unavailable for this 9Router version.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Order models by preference. 9Router applies the route when a supported agent starts a new session.
routes.name: Route name
routes.nameHelp: Use letters, numbers, underscores, periods, and hyphens only.
routes.noSelectedModels: Add at least one model to this route.
routes.boundWarning: This route is selected by an agent. Switch that agent to Native login or another route to avoid failed sessions.
routes.unavailable: Route details are unavailable for this 9Router version.

usage.title: Usage & limits
usage.description: Review 9Router usage estimates and configure optional advisory thresholds.

dashboard.title: Usage estimate
dashboard.estimate: Values are reported by 9Router and may differ from provider billing.

usage.connectFirst: Connect 9Router to view usage and configure advisory limits.
usage.unavailable: This 9Router version does not expose compatible usage data.
usage.empty: No usage recorded for this period.
usage.stale: 9Router returned a cached snapshot. Advisory alerts are paused until fresh usage is available.

providers.title: Provider distribution
providers.empty: No provider distribution is available for this period.

alerts.title: Advisory alerts
alerts.description: Notify through your existing notification channels after fresh usage reaches a threshold.
alerts.thresholdHelp: Enter a non-negative USD amount with up to six decimal places.
alerts.invalidThreshold: Enter a non-negative USD amount with no more than six decimal places.
alerts.advisory: Advisory only. 9Router remains the billing authority, and CloudCLI does not block requests or enforce spend limits.
